howto.name: Upload multiple PDFs
howto.text: Drag 2 to 50 PDF files. They go up in one request, so together they can be up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Know what it does
howto.text: There is no level to pick. Each PDF is rewritten without unused objects and with its streams compressed. Images are not downsampled or re-encoded, so photo-heavy files shrink little; use Compress PDF for image compression levels.

howto.name: Compress and download as ZIP
howto.text: Click Compress. Files are processed in parallel, up to four at a time, and the results come back in one ZIP, in upload order.

faq.q: How many PDFs can I upload?
faq.a: Between 2 and 50 files per batch. They are sent in one upload, so together they must fit within 500 MB.
Yes. The server compresses up to four files at once in a shared pool of worker threads, so a large batch still takes longer than a single file.

faq.q: How much smaller will my files get?
faq.a: It depends on how much waste a file carries. Batch Compress removes unused objects and compresses streams, but it does not touch images: in a test, a PDF made of one JPEG photo shrank by less than 0.1 %. For image compression, use Compress PDF, which offers Light, Recommended and Extreme levels.
